title: terminal-code: a VS Code window where every pixel is drawn into your terminal grid
description:
terminal-code runs VS Code in your terminal by stacking two pieces: code-server puts VS Code in a browser, and their terminal-browser renders that browser through the kitty graphics protocol. It's real VS Code, drawn as pixels in your terminal grid. Over SSH, tode --ssh keeps the frontend local and only the backend remote, so you're not shipping every frame across the network. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/zenbu-labs/terminal-code
